SELECT
  LTRIM(RTRIM(i.CODE)) AS Code,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(i.NAME)) AS Title,
  N'1' AS ProductType,
  CASE WHEN ISNULL(i.ACTIVE, 0) = 0 THEN N'Evet' ELSE N'Hayır' END AS IsActive,
  N'Adet' AS DefaultUnitID
FROM dbo.LG_421_ITEMS i WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE i.CARDTYPE IN (1, 4, 10, 11, 12, 13)
  AND i.CODE IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(i.CODE)) <> N''
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(i.CODE)) NOT LIKE N'ÿ%'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  LTRIM(RTRIM(s.CODE)) AS Code,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(s.DEFINITION_)) AS Title,
  CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.CARDTYPE, 1) = 2 THEN N'3' ELSE N'2' END AS ProductType,
  CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.ACTIVE, 0) = 0 THEN N'Evet' ELSE N'Hayır' END AS IsActive,
  N'Adet' AS DefaultUnitID
FROM dbo.LG_421_SRVCARD s WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE s.CODE IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(s.CODE)) <> N''
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(s.CODE)) NOT LIKE N'ÿ%'
ORDER BY Code
